toolkit.title: The free toolkit
toolkit.text:
A free set of printable one-page tools for the weeks when things are hard: a daily check-in, a list of early warning signs of burnout, a weekly energy budget, a card for interrupting overthinking, a spending-spiral tracker, and a Sunday reset routine. It also has printable copies of the worksheets in this book, so you can fill them in more than once.

The toolkit comes as a PDF by email. Signing up adds you to the J.M. Struijk email list, and every email has a one-click unsubscribe link. This book is complete without it.

books.title: The ADHD Tax
books.subtitle: Recovering from Impulsive Spending and Financial Chaos
books.kindle_subtitle: Stop Impulsive Spending, Forgotten Bills & Subscription Chaos
books.pitch: Explains how ADHD can make everyday life cost more, and sets up simple systems for bills, subscriptions and impulse spending.

books.title: The ADHD Budget Workbook
books.subtitle: 90-Day Financial Reset for Adults with ADHD
books.pitch: Walks you through 90 days of short daily steps to set up a first budget and start an emergency fund.

books.title: The ADHD Side Hustle
books.subtitle: Turn Your Hyperfocus Into Extra Income Without Burning Out
books.pitch: Helps you choose, price and run a side income that fits how you work, with US tax basics and workload limits to help prevent burnout.

books.title: The ADHD Debt Payoff Workbook
books.subtitle: A Step-by-Step Workbook to Help You Pay Off Debt, Build Momentum, and Create Financial Freedom
books.pitch: Guides you through listing your debts, picking a payoff order, dealing with creditors and collectors, and knowing when to get outside help.

books.title: The ADHD Budget Planner
books.subtitle: The Undated 12-Month Money Management System for Adults with ADHD
books.pitch: Gives you a year of undated monthly plans, irregular-bill tracking and weekly money check-ins to keep a budget going after setup.

books.title: The ADHD Overthinking Reset
books.subtitle: Break Free from Mental Loops, Calm Overwhelm, and Stop Spiraling—Even When Your Brain Won't Shut Up
books.kindle_subtitle: Break Free from Mental Loops, Quiet Intrusive Thoughts, and Stop Spiraling — Even When Your Brain Won't Shut Up
books.pitch: Gives you short tools for stepping out of mental loops, and helps you tell everyday overthinking apart from anxiety, OCD or depression.

books.title: The ADHD Eating Reset
books.subtitle: Stop the Shame Spiral, Fix Your Relationship with Food, and Actually Eat—Without Meal Plans or Willpower
books.kindle_subtitle: End Meal Paralysis, Stop Forgetting to Eat, and Build Food Habits Your ADHD Brain Will Actually Keep
books.pitch: Offers practical help with forgetting to eat, meal paralysis and stimulant appetite changes, with no diets, meal plans or weight-loss goals.

books.title: The ADHD Decision Reset
books.subtitle: Break Analysis Paralysis, Make Choices Faster, and Stop Overthinking Everything—From What to Eat to What to Do With Your Life
books.pitch: Matches decision methods to the size of the choice, so small decisions go faster and big ones get a slower, more careful process.

books.title: The Late-Diagnosed ADHD Workbook
books.subtitle: Practical Tools for Focus, Time, Big Feelings, and Burnout — for Adults Who Found Out Later
books.pitch: Helps you make sense of a late ADHD diagnosis, gives an overview of treatment options, and has worksheets for focus, time and emotions.

books.title: The Late-Diagnosed Autistic Workbook
books.subtitle: Practical Tools for Sensory Overload, Masking, and Burnout — for Adults Who Found Out Later
books.pitch: Helps adults who found out late that they are autistic map their sensory needs, look at masking, and plan for burnout and accommodations.

books.title: The Late-Diagnosed AuDHD Workbook
books.pitch: Covers what is specific to having both ADHD and autism, such as routine versus novelty, combined burnout and planning energy for both.

books.title: The Autism Masking Reset
books.subtitle: How to Stop Performing Neurotypical, Reclaim Your Energy, and Start Living as Your Actual Self
books.pitch: Explains what autistic masking is and what it costs, then helps you choose where and how to unmask safely at work and at home.

books.title: The ADHD Burnout Recovery Guide
books.subtitle: Recognize the Signs, Stop the Crash, and Rebuild Your Energy—Without Quitting Everything
books.kindle_subtitle: Triage, Recovery, and Prevention for the Brain You Actually Have
books.pitch: Helps you spot ADHD burnout early, get through the crash and rebuild your energy, and explains how burnout differs from depression.

books.title: The ADHD Medication Companion
books.subtitle: A Tracking and Appointment-Prep Workbook for Adults Starting or Adjusting Treatment
books.pitch: Gives you logs for starting or changing ADHD medication, pages to prepare for appointments, and the rules for renewing Schedule II prescriptions.
